commands.name: health
commands.summary: Check that mail-control answers, and the domain and counts it serves. Changes nothing.

commands.name: mailbox ensure
commands.summary: Set up the agent's mailbox and delegated mail; new keys come back once.

args.name: agentId
args.description: The agent's id: 2 to 63 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

owner-email.description: The email address of the family member who delegates their mail to this agent.

source.description: Where the delegated mail comes from. Defaults to hey when an owner email is given.

source-tag.description: A short tag that tells this source's mail apart.

commands.name: mailbox rotate-keys
commands.summary: Replace the mailbox's or source grant's keys; the old keys stop working for new mail.

args.name: agentId
args.description: The agent's id: 2 to 63 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.

owner-email.description: The email address of the family member who delegates their mail to this agent.

source.description: Where the delegated mail comes from. Defaults to hey when an owner email is given.

source-tag.description: A short tag that tells this source's mail apart.

rotate-source-grant.description: Replace the delegated source grant's keys.

reason.description: Why the keys change, in a short line.
